question: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?

options.text: Miyan Tansen - One of the nine jewels

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ustad Bismillah Khan - Sitar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bismillah Khan **(born **Qamaruddin Khan) **often referred to by the title **Ustad**, was an **Indian musician **credited with **popularizing the shehnai**, a reeded woodwind instrument.
 
• While the **shehnai **had long held **importance as a folk instrument **played primarily schooled in **traditional ceremonies**, **Khan **is credited with **elevating its status and bringing it to the concert stage**.
 
• He **was awarded India's highest civilian honor**, the **Bharat Ratna, in 2001**, becoming the **third classical musician **of India after M. S. **Subbalakshmi and Ravi Shankar **to be **awarded the Bharat Ratna**.
 
• He was **born on 21 March 1916 in Dumraon**, Shahabad district, Bihar and Orissa Province, British India.
 
• 
 He **died on 21 August 2006 (aged 90) in Varanasi**, Uttar Pradesh, India.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bismillah Khan** often referred to by the title Ustad, was an Indian musician credited with popularizing the shehnai, a reeded woodwind instrument.
 
• Hariprasad Chaurasia is an Indian music director and classical flutist, who plays the flute, in the Hindustani classical tradition.
 
• Tansen was a prominent Classical Music Composer & Musician. He was an extraordinarily gifted vocalist, known for a large number of compositions.
 
• Ali Akbar Khan was an Indian Hindustani classical musician of the Maihar Gharana, known for his virtuosity in playing the sarod.
